name: Qualifacts iQ
short_description: AI solution for behavioral health across Qualifacts EHRs offering documentation automation, scheduling agents, and billing workflow optimization.
long_description: Qualifacts iQ is an AI solution purpose-built for behavioral healthcare, integrated across Qualifacts' Credible, CareLogic, and InSync EHR platforms. The suite includes iQ Assistant (always-on AI chatbot for instant EHR support), iQ Clinical Documentation (reducing note-taking from 15 to 3 minutes - 80% reduction), iQ Agent for Scheduling (chat-based AI for complex scheduling), and iQ Agent for Billing (automated workflows for financial performance). Qualifacts iQ supports AI-powered documentation in 120+ languages and has achieved ISO 42001 certification for AI Management Systems. The platform has saved 50,000+ customer hours with 2-3X realized ROI. Trusted by 2,200+ behavioral health agencies nationwide, Qualifacts iQ includes the free iQ Assistant browser extension trained on 3,000+ knowledge base articles.
one_liner: AI suite for Qualifacts EHRs with documentation, scheduling, and billing automation.
best_for: Community mental health centers using Qualifacts EHR platforms
CCBHCs seeking integrated AI documentation and workflow automation
Large behavioral health organizations wanting comprehensive AI across clinical and billing
Agencies using Credible, CareLogic, or InSync needing AI-assisted support
not_for: Practices not using Qualifacts EHR platforms
Solo practitioners or small private practices
Organizations seeking standalone AI scribe functionality
Practices outside behavioral health and IDD services

pricing.notes: iQ Assistant is free for all Qualifacts customers via browser extension. iQ Clinical Documentation, Scheduling Agent, and Billing Agent are paid add-ons with enterprise pricing. Contact Qualifacts for quote.

compliance.notes: SOC II and ONC standards compliant. ISO 42001 certified for AI Management Systems. Data stays secure within Qualifacts EHR infrastructure.

seo.meta_description: Qualifacts iQ review. AI-powered documentation, scheduling, and billing for Credible, CareLogic, and InSync EHR platforms. 80% reduction in note-taking time.

faqs.a: Qualifacts iQ is an AI solution for behavioral healthcare that includes iQ Assistant (free AI chatbot), iQ Clinical Documentation (80% reduction in note time), iQ Agent for Scheduling, and iQ Agent for Billing. It's integrated across Credible, CareLogic, and InSync EHRs.

faqs.q: How much does Qualifacts iQ cost?
faqs.a: iQ Assistant is free for all Qualifacts customers as a browser extension. iQ Clinical Documentation, Scheduling Agent, and Billing Agent are paid add-ons. Contact Qualifacts for enterprise pricing.

faqs.q: How much time does Qualifacts iQ save on documentation?
faqs.a: Qualifacts iQ Clinical Documentation reduces note-taking time from 15 minutes to 3 minutes - an 80% reduction. Overall, the platform has saved 50,000+ customer hours with 2-3X realized ROI.

faqs.q: Which EHRs does Qualifacts iQ work with?
faqs.a: Qualifacts iQ is available for Credible, CareLogic, and InSync EHR platforms. iQ Clinical Documentation also integrates with OnCall Virtual Care telehealth solution.
